name: OWASP ZAP
description: In the reviewed ZAP add-on path, each add-on entry supplies a URL and an algorithm-qualified hash through ZapVersions.xml; the downloader computes that digest and only marks a matching file validated before installation. This is an integrity check tied to the retrieved manifest, not evidence that the manifest or its transport is cryptographically signed.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the reviewed source does not establish authentication or signing of ZapVersions.xml, and external release artifacts were not inspected.
